messages:
sec-bot: :rotating_light: SCIM deprovision job failed intermittently for tenant `acme-corp` (503s). Observed transient KMS principal left behind — possible permission drift. Notified eng-security.

marta: grabbing context. which deploy changed SCIM behaviour recently? :eyes: 

devin: pushed RBAC refactor last night (hash `f3a2d9c`). We split role inheritance logic to speed group resolution. No intentional change to deprov flows but the timing changed.

ops-eli: seeing same in reconciler metrics — deprovision task retried then marked succeeded while downstream KMS delete returned 500. Could be a race where account marked "removed" before KMS principal removal finished.

marta: can we confirm who has admin access to the leftover principals? urgent for compliance.

devin: quick check: logs show provisioner responded OK at T+0, but KMS deletion at T+1 returned 500; reconcile later didn't re-run for that user due to optimistic tombstone state. snippet:```
INFO Provisioner: user-id=U123 tombstone=true
ERROR KMS delete principal: principal=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/foo 500
```

tay: audit logs? do we have entries for the failed KMS calls? that's crucial for the SOC report.

ops-eli: weird — CloudTrail has the KMS DeleteKey attempts, but our app-level audit events for the deprovision step are missing between 03:12:45 and 03:14:00. Logging agent rotated during a deploy. Deploy-bot: `deploy user/provisioner f3a2d9c -> prod` at 03:12:50.

ashley: so a deploy overlapped with deprov causing missing app-audit entries, and error path wasn't retried. Compliance gap. What mitigation?

marta: immediate mitigations: 1) run targeted reconcile for acme-corp principals, 2) create a temporary guard to block marking tombstone until KMS deletion confirmed, 3) backfill audit entries from CloudTrail into our audit store.

devin: I can patch guard in the provisioner: flip tombstone commit behind a `kms_delete_confirmed` check. Will open a hotfix PR now.

ops-eli: running reconcile job now: `/internal/provisioner/reconcile --tenant acme-corp --only-kms` (run id r-202103). curl example:```
curl -X POST "https://internal.api/reconcile" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","mode":"kms-only"}'
```

sec-bot: Recon job started r-202103. Will post results.

tay: for audit backfill, I'll coordinate with infra to ingest CloudTrail events and tag them with `source:cloudtrail` and map to app events. Might need help from security analytics.

ashley: heads-up to compliance: provisional note drafted. We'll include timeline and mitigation steps after recon results.

sec-bot: Recon job completed: 7 principals deleted, 2 required manual remediation (stuck HSM bindings).

marta: good. keep log of manual remediations (who did what). Also schedule an on-call blameless postmortem to cover deploy window protections.

devin: PR opened: `hotfix/prov-tombstone-kms-wait` — adding idempotent retry for KMS deletes + guard. Will request urgent review from eng-runtime.

ops-eli: deploying hotfix to staging now. will run integration test that simulates KMS 500 responses.

ashley: thanks all. action items summarized: 1) run backfill (tay), 2) hotfix review/deploy (devin/ops-eli), 3) manual remediation log (marta), 4) compliance note (ashley).

sec-bot: Incident tag: `INC-2026-1042` created. Assigned to eng-security. :white_check_mark: 

marta: assigning follow-ups in Asana. we should also add a regression test to our e2e suite to ensure tombstone gating.

devin: on it — will add test that fakes KMS transient errors and verifies tombstone isn't committed.

ashley: nice. once hotfix is in prod, let's run a full tenant reconcile for last 24h to be safe.

sec-bot: Note: audit backfill completed partially; 03:12:30-03:15:00 window done. Remaining windows queued.

marta: closing interim triage. will reconvene if any other drift found. thanks everyone.
